name: Mountain Lizard

review.observation: Full original: granular-scaled slender body, long banded tail exceeding head-and-body length, bent sprawling near limbs and long clawed toes. Three feet are independently readable; fourth/far hindlimb remains unresolved behind the near thigh. HOLD for missing independent fourth-limb visibility. Broad margins.

decisions.paintingObservation: No paired projecting mammalian pinnae are depicted. Any ear opening, tympanum, protective ear flap, casque, horn, neck frill or external gill remains natural head/neck paint; none is a substitute pinna.
